# Trade Born project instructions

## Project

- This is a frontend-only React 19, TypeScript, and Vite application.
- Application source and styles live in `src/`; the HTML entry point is `index.html`.
- The prototype uses client-side History API routing and is deployed as a static site.
- There is no backend. Do not imply that prototype forms send or store information.

## Working conventions

- Follow the existing component, styling, and accessibility patterns.
- Keep changes focused and avoid adding dependencies unless needed.
- Preserve responsive behavior and support reduced motion for animations.
- Do not invent regulatory status, financial performance, credentials, or legal claims. Treat these as unverified until supplied and approved by the project owner.

## Validation

- Run `npm run build` after application changes.
- Keep generated files and dependencies out of commits; `dist/` and `node_modules/` are not source files.
